title: Previous promotion PR #285 was closed
body: PR #285 'Publish dev → production' was closed on 2026-06-17 without being merged. Verify there was no blocking issue before merging #290.
rationale: If #285 was closed for a reason, that reason may still apply to #290

title: Tag and GitHub release after PR merge
body: After PR #290 is merged, run release-publish to tag the commit and create GitHub release. Current last tag is v0.25.11.
rationale: release-publish creates the actual version tag and GitHub release
